tasks.title: Announcement #67
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement at a student meeting.
tasks.transcript: Our mentorship program is back this year with some great new features like regularly scheduled one on one sessions and extra resources to support participants. Senior students will once again be paired with freshmen to help them navigate their first year. As a mentor, you'll gain real leadership experience and feel the reward of helping someone succeed. Sign up at the Student Center, Room 104. Fill out a quick application, including a short statement about why you're interested. Nothing too formal, just a few lines.

questions.stem: Which of the following is true about the mentorship program?

options.A: Each mentor is paired with a faculty advisor.
options.B: The program will replace orientation for freshmen.
options.C: Only students with prior mentoring experience can apply.
options.D: Some improvements have been made since last year.

questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：关于这个导师项目，以下哪项是正确的？ 定位原文：Our mentorship program is back this year with some great new features like regularly scheduled one on one sessions and extra resources to support participants. 选项分析： A. Each mentor is paired with a faculty advisor. 每位导师都配有一名教师顾问。公告中说的是高年级学生与新生结对，未提及教师顾问，所以A选项错误。 B. The program will replace orientation for freshmen. 该项目将取代新生的入学导向活动。公告中未提及取代任何活动，所以B选项错误。 C. Only students with prior mentoring experience can apply. 只有有导师经验的学生才能申请。公告中未要求有经验，所以C选项错误。 D. Some improvements have been made since last year. 自去年以来已经做出了一些改进。公告明确说项目今年回归，并带有“great new features”（很棒的新功能），说明有改进，所以D选项正确。

questions.stem: What should a student submit when signing up?

options.B: A copy of their class schedule
options.C: A brief explanation of their interest

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：学生在报名时需要提交什么？ 定位原文：Fill out a quick application, including a short statement about why you're interested. Nothing too formal, just a few lines. 选项分析： A. A letter of recommendation 一封推荐信。公告中未提及推荐信，所以A选项错误。 B. A copy of their class schedule 一份课程表副本。公告中未提及课程表，所以B选项错误。 C. A brief explanation of their interest 一份关于自己兴趣的简要说明。公告要求写“why you're interested”（为什么感兴趣），“just a few lines”（几句话），所以C选项正确。 D. A résumé and cover letter 一份简历和求职信。公告中未要求简历或正式的求职信，并强调“nothing too formal”（不需要太正式），所以D选项错误。
